def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs['n']  # number of people
    k = inputs['k']  # every k-th person is eliminated
    
    # Create a list of people (positions 1 to n)
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    current_index = 0
    
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Move k positions (k-1 steps forward from current position)
        current_index = (current_index + k - 1) % len(people)
        # Remove the person at this position
        people.pop(current_index)
        # Adjust index if it's now out of bounds
        if current_index >= len(people) and len(people) > 0:
            current_index = 0
    
    return float(people[0])
